result:
**M08 passes in round 1**, after one small fix I made myself.

**Fix F1** (`frontend/src/styles/_tokens.scss`, 5 lines): the two shadow tokens `--qf-shadow-1` and `--qf-shadow-2` wrapped whole shadow values in `light-dark()`. That function only accepts colours, so any element using these shadows would have ended up with no shadow at all. Nothing uses them yet (they first appear in M10), so this was caught early. They now switch only the colours inside each shadow layer. After the fix I re-ran the build and the colour check, and confirmed in the browser that the dark-theme shadow now resolves to a valid value.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Review of the uncommitted changes and new files | All 11 tasks (T101–T111) are really in the code. Only the two allowed style files contain colour literals, and no existing test id was removed. |
| `ng build` | Passes with no warnings. Exactly one Inter font file (48 kB); about 144 kB transferred on first load. |
| Swagger vs contract | Match |
| `./mvnw verify` | 188 tests, 0 failures |
| curl regression | 7 suites (M01–M07), 0 failures. Run after restarting the backend on a fresh database. |
| E2E-M08-01..07 on the real stack | Pass. Contrast has 0 failures on all six pages, in both light and dark. Every network request stays on localhost, and all 26 icons load. |
| Earlier smoke scenarios (M01-01 to M06-01) | Pass, run in dark theme. They include a real plan that started at 12:33 with its banner. |
| Console and network | No console errors, no server errors |

- **Not fully tested:** E2E-M08-04 ("System" follows the OS) only covers the light-OS case. The browser tool can't switch the OS to dark, so the dark-OS path was checked by reading the code only.
- **Shared backend:** while I was testing, the display name on the :8090 backend changed to "Ahmed AbdelDaiem" without this session saving Settings. Someone else was probably using that backend at the same time. It didn't affect any check.
- **Blocked commands:** two commands were refused automatically because this session has no approval prompt: a Maven run with an exit-code echo, and a `git -C` diff. I re-ran both in plain form and they worked.

The report lists a few small, non-blocking items for M09–M11. One example: the pre-paint background in `index.html` overrides the theme's page background on the `<html>` element. The page body covers it, so it shows only when you scroll past the edge.

Files are in `loops/verify/`:
- `outputs/M08-round-1.md` (the report)
- `outputs/evidence/M08/round-1/` (browser results, curl log, Swagger export)
- `progress.md` (appended)
- `state/handoff.md` (rewritten)
- `state/verdict.json` (written last)

Screenshots stayed in `run-artifacts/playwright/verify-M08-r1-*.png`, because copying them into the evidence folder isn't allowed in this session. Nothing was committed, and the stack is still running for the runner to stop.
